initial.text:
The shape of a sentence
A good editor lets you follow a thought. The words should stay steady as a sentence grows, wraps, and finds its rhythm.
Select a few words and make them bold or italic. Click in either pane to write; the other follows along.
Typography has small surprises: office, affinity, café, naïve, and a carefully placed em dash — all deserve a proper home.
